Located around a 10-minute drive from a convenient place to shop such as Vietnam National Convention Centre, this Hanoi hotel provides 25 rooms. The hotel is 2.7 km from Vietnam Ethnological Museum of Ethnology, while the President Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is approximately 7 km away. Sports fans can also visit My Dinh Stadium, about a 15-minute ride from the fantastic Phu Ha Noi Hotel & Spa - My Dinh Hanoi, and take their families to the Thống Nhất Park, which is about a 20-minute ride away. The mixed-use supertall skyscraper "Keangnam Landmark Tower 72" is not far from the property. The nearest bus stop is Truoc 100m nga 4 Nguyen Hoang - Pham Hung, located merely 250 metres away, and Ha Noi train station is around 7 km away. The air-conditioned rooms in An Phu Ha Noi Hotel & Spa - My Dinh have a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and Wi-Fi along with blackout drapes and air conditioning. There is a private bathroom in the rooms. Bathrooms are equipped with a bidet, a separate toilet, and a shower, as well as comforts such as hairdryers and bath sheets. Also, the rooms with views of the city are provided for guests' comfort. For an enjoyable stay, the Phu Ha Noi Hotel & Spa - My Dinh Hanoi offers the Asian restaurant serving Asian dishes. Ah Yat Abalone Restaurant is located next to the hotel and serves Chinese dishes, nearly 5 minutes' walk from the property.
